question: What is the meaning of detailed information about components in relation to product composition?
description: Detailed information about components in relation to product composition refers to providing specific details about the materials and substances that make up a product. This includes specifying the mass fraction of each material, identifying any hazardous substances present, indicating the source of recycled content, and disclosing the threshold levels at which the product composition is disclosed. This level of detail ensures transparency and clarity regarding the composition of the product, helping stakeholders understand its environmental impact and compliance with relevant standards.
